title: Fix draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md: blocked-sender suppression incomplete
description: WSS spec covers blocked-sender suppression for ring/end events but NOT for 6 in-call event types: VTCParticipantEvent, VTCMediaStateEvent, VTCActiveSpeakerEvent, VTCUnmuteRequestEvent, VTCRecordingStateEvent, VTCCaptionEvent. A blocked user joining a room call can still leak presence/activity via these events to the blocker. Pattern: if sender is on recipient's blocked list (ChatContact.blocked=true), the event MUST be silently dropped. Matches the existing pattern for ChatTypingEvent (filed previously as dim0).
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
